recent_posts.summary: xAI has launched Grok 4.3 on its API, positioning it as their fastest and most capable model yet. It claims top rankings on Artificial Analysis leaderboards for agentic tool calling and instruction following, and ranks #1 on Vals AI enterprise benchmarks including case law and corporate finance. The model supports a 1 million token context window and is priced at $1.25/million input tokens and $2.50/million output tokens.

recent_posts.title:
Voice Cloning is now live via the xAI API!

Create a custom voice in less than 2 minutes or select from our library of 80+ voices across 28 languages to personalize your voice agents, audiobooks, video game characters, and more.
recent_posts.summary: xAI has launched a Voice Cloning feature via its API, enabling developers to create custom voices in under 2 minutes or choose from a library of 80+ voices spanning 28 languages. The feature targets use cases like voice agents, audiobooks, and video game characters.

Introducing Grok Voice Think Fast 1.0

A state-of-the-art voice model built for complex, multi-step workflows with snappy responses and high accuracy.

It takes the top spot on the Tau Voice Bench and handles real-world messiness like noise, accents, and interruptions better than any other model in the world.
recent_posts.summary: xAI has released Grok Voice Think Fast 1.0, a voice model designed for complex multi-step workflows with fast response times and high accuracy. It claims the top position on the Tau Voice Bench and is built to handle real-world audio challenges including background noise, diverse accents, and interruptions.
